title: El papel
goal: Get a document notarised without understanding it
culture: Un papel is any document at all, and admitting you do not know which one you need is the fastest route to the right one. She has read the letter you were given and she knows exactly what it is asking for.

beats.good: Un papel is any document there is. Say it and she will work out which one you mean rather better than you can.

beats.es: ¿Qué tipo de papel? ¿Un poder, una constancia?
beats.en: I don’t know. Could you do it for me?
ok: no se usted me lo hace
beats.good: Admitting it is the fastest route to the right document. She has read the letter you were handed and she knows what it wants.

beats.es: Sí, se lo hago y se lo notarizo.
beats.objective: Ask the price before she starts
beats.good: Ask before she starts typing. A notarised page has a price and it is not written down anywhere in the room.
